subject: Proposal: Curb wait-zone & hybrid fleet for Atlas workshop
messages:
From: Cordelia Hayes <cordelia@urbanfleet.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-15T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Proposal: Curb wait-zone + hybrid fleet for Atlas Data Systems workshop

Hi Neha —

Thanks for the details earlier. Attached is a preliminary operating concept for the Atlas Data Systems two-day onsite (site_plan_v1.pdf) and a ballpark pricing estimate (pricing_estimate.xlsx). High-level summary below: 

- Goal: eliminate sidewalk congestion during arrival windows and reduce shuttle idle time while preserving VIP limo access.
- Proposal: temporary curb wait-zone (marked lanes A/B), staged hybrid fleet (10 EV shuttles for general attendees + 3 reserved car services for execs), and a shared short-term rental pool for overflow.
- Staging & security: we coordinate a 15-minute hold area 0.2 miles from main entrance with continuous shuttle loops. We will provide on-site attendants and radio channel for venue security.
- Parking passes: we can pre-print 120 drop-off permits and 20 staging permits for vendor vehicles.

Open questions for Redwood: pick-up window tolerances (15 vs 20 min), whether VIPs require covered transfer lanes, and preferred credentialing for our attendants when meeting venue security.

Cost estimate (from pricing_estimate.xlsx): base ops $4,800/day + $95 per shuttle-hour + $200 per reserved car for transfers. Discounts available with a signed operating agreement this week.

If helpful I can run a quick site-walk with Marissa and Karthik tomorrow morning.

Best,
Cordelia Hayes
Director, Corporate Events & Operations
UrbanFleet Services

Attachments: site_plan_v1.pdf (diagram), pricing_estimate.xlsx (xls)
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Cordelia Hayes <cordelia@urbanfleet.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-15T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: Curb wait-zone + hybrid fleet for Atlas Data Systems workshop

Thanks, Cordelia — this looks promising. A few clarifying items before we route to procurement: 

1) Arrival windows: we currently have staggered guest arrivals between 08:30–09:20 and 13:00–13:40. Can your loops guarantee a maximum average wait of 8–10 minutes for shuttles during peak? We want sub-12 minute SLA for attendees.
2) VIP transfers: yes, execs require covered transfer lanes and a designated valet footprint adjacent to the main entrance. Can you scope a covered tent or coordinate with the venue for weather contingency?
3) Credentialing: Red badge + vendor lanyard is preferred; we'll ask venue security to accept a pre-approved attendant list. I'll send names for access tomorrow.
4) Parking passes: Marcus Lin will coordinate vehicle passes. Marcus, please confirm lot allocation (north lot preferred).
5) Billing & contract cadence: we need a PO-ready quote and a DocuSign link for signature. Rishi — please look out for the final pricing if this is moving to procurement.

Marissa — can you confirm if a site walk is possible tomorrow 10:30am? Karthik, I flagged logistics questions about curb access and vendor radio channels.

If all good, we should sign the operating agreement and lock a delivery date three days before the event for signage and printed passes.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Program Manager, Events
Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com

Neha — thanks for the speedy notes. Quick answers inline: 

1) Shuttle SLA: with the proposed 10-shuttle rotation and a 0.2-mile staging area we can target an average attendee wait of 7–9 minutes peak (worst-case 12). We'll add a priority buffer for the first two morning waves.
2) VIP covered transfer: yes — we can provide a pop-up covered walkway (weather-rated to 25 mph wind). If the venue can supply tent anchors we can skip the weighted systems and save $350.
3) Credentialing: agreeable. Please send the pre-approved list 48 hours prior. We'll check in with venue security and provide radios (channel 4) to all attendants.
4) Parking: north lot has capacity for our staging; we'll reserve 18 spots and pre-print 20 passes as requested.

I uploaded a consolidated operating plan with final routing and attendant roles: final_operating_plan.pdf

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/transactions/ABCD-1234 (proposal/operating agreement)

If you approve I'll send a PO-ready quote and schedule the site walk for 10:30 tomorrow. Alternatively, Liam at PremierCar (ops@premiercarservices.com) is standing by if you prefer a larger sedan fleet for exec transfers.

Best,
Cordelia
